claims.statement: Tom Allen and Bill Davis were to fight for the pugilistic championship on 12 January 1869; whoever failed to appear on the ground would lose the match.
claims.excerpt:
Bill Davis, of St. Louis, and Tom
Allen, of California, to come off on the 12th of Jan-
uary,

claims.statement: Seven or eight men said to be backers of Tom Allen attacked Bill Davis at Doyle's, near the Fair Grounds, on Christmas night; one of them cut Davis's wrist with a knife.
claims.excerpt:
Seven or cight rowdies, sald to be backers of Alen,
determined to render Davis powerless.
places: Doyle's, near the Fair Grounds, St. Louis

fights.excerpt:
Bill Davis, of St. Louis, and Tom
Allen, of California, to come off on the 12th of Jan-
uary,
fights.notes: Planned bout. The paper calls Allen 'of California' and Davis 'of St. Louis'; other items say Davis was of California and Allen of Cleveland.

notes: The Christmas attack is said to be by Allen's backers; Allen is not shown taking part.
